message.content: I’m not entirely sure how they were discovered, as I was just told about the nodules during my examination. Regarding my symptoms, I have noticed some mild darkening of the skin over my finger joints and knees. I haven't had any fevers, night sweats, or a cough. I don't really have any other symptoms to report at the moment.
